name: Disneyland Ronto Roasters Classic Ronto Wrap (Roasted Pork & Sausage in Pita — No Slaw/Sauce Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Ronto Roasters (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Sliced slow-roasted pork and grilled sausage in a warm, soft pita bread are dairy-free and high-protein once you hold the crunchy cabbage slaw and peppercorn "clutch" sauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ronto Wrap with **NO slaw** and **NO peppercorn sauce** (just the roasted pork, sausage, and warm pita).
watchOuts: Standard wrap is topped with raw cabbage slaw and spicy Sichuan peppercorn sauce—must order plain
